shell.personaHint: Demo control: switch between synthetic personas. Ownership and roles are still enforced by the server.
shell.resetConfirm: Reset all synthetic data to the seeded state? Uploads and demo actions will be cleared.
academics.att.subtitle: Absences you can still excuse come first. Every session is its own record, so an excuse is tied to the exact class you missed.
academics.att.allClear: No absence is waiting for an excuse.
academics.att.windowNote: An excuse is due within {days} days of the session (demo value).
academics.att.pastDeadlineNote: These are older than {days} days. You can still send an excuse, but the department may not accept it.
academics.att.findHelp: Describe the class you missed: a course code or name, a day (“yesterday”, “last Monday”) or a date (21/09). It searches only your own sessions this term.
academics.att.demoPolicy: These thresholds are demo values, not a published YU regulation.
academics.att.noneMissed: No missed sessions in this course.
academics.plan.generalHelp: Humanities and general-education electives broaden your degree; any course from this list fills the slot.
academics.plan.majorHelp: Major electives deepen your specialisation; pick one that fits your interests and the prerequisites you have.
academics.req.title: Graduation requirements
academics.req.subtitle: Where your credits count towards the degree, and what is left.
academics.overview.noProgram: No program on record for this account.
academics.overview.noActions: Nothing needs your attention right now.
academics.plan.title: Degree plan
academics.plan.subtitle: Your official study plan, semester by semester, matched to your transcript.
academics.plan.graphAria: Prerequisite graph of the program courses
academics.plan.graphHint: Select a course to highlight everything it needs and everything it unlocks. Dashed lines mean "either of".
academics.plan.neverCounted: Enrolled and planned credits are shown for orientation only; they count once a passing grade is recorded.
academics.register.title: Registration agent
academics.register.subtitle: Plan {term}: options respect prerequisites, seats, time conflicts, travel gaps and the credit limit. You approve the exact list before anything is submitted.
academics.register.nlLabel: Tell the agent what matters to you
academics.register.nlHint: Rules are parsed deterministically (no model needed). Recognised phrases show up as chips on the proposal.
academics.register.countInProgressHint: Conditional on passing: flagged as a warning, never hidden
academics.register.keepWindow: Protect a weekly window (workshop, work, club)
academics.register.generateHint: Creates a reviewable proposal: nothing is registered yet.
academics.register.unknownBody: The portal timed out after operation {op} was sent. Nothing is resubmitted automatically: reconcile by checking the status.
academics.register.noOptionsBody: Relax a preference (e.g. allow Thursday) or count in-progress courses, then generate again.
academics.register.emptyBasket: The basket is empty: choose an option or add a course.
academics.register.finalReviewHint: The exact section ids and total credits below are what gets submitted. Any edit invalidates the approval.
academics.register.duplicateInfo: Both submissions returned the same receipt, so there is no double enrolment.
academics.register.swapHint: Pick another section of the same course; checks are re-run and the approval is invalidated.
academics.register.addHint: Only eligible courses with open sections can be added.
academics.timetable.title: Timetable
academics.timetable.empty: No enrolled sections in this term
academics.timetable.emptyBody: Confirmed registrations appear here with room links.
academics.attendance.title: Attendance
academics.attendance.subtitle: Every session is its own record. Select an Absent chip to draft an excuse for that exact session.
academics.attendance.resolveTitle: Excuse an absence by describing it
academics.attendance.resolvePlaceholder: e.g. yesterday's absence, last Monday SWE 302, 21/09
academics.attendance.deadlineNote: Excuses within {days} days of the session
academics.attendance.newExcuseHint: The draft is bound to the attendance ids below, not to the course name.
academics.excuses.title: Excuse requests
academics.excuses.subtitle: Draft → Ready → Approved → Submitted → Under review → Accepted / Rejected / Needs information. Attendance changes only after acceptance.
academics.excuses.noneBody: Start from an Absent session on the attendance page.
academics.excuses.noChangeNote: Submitting does not change your attendance. The record is updated only if the department accepts the request.
academics.excuses.absencesHint: These attendance records are bound to the request by id.
academics.excuses.reasonHint: Short and factual: the reviewing department reads this.
academics.excuses.referenceHint: Optional; extracted from the evidence when possible.
academics.excuses.evidenceMedical: Upload your existing Sehhaty report. The original is stored unchanged; only dates and the reference are extracted for a preview you can edit.
academics.excuses.evidenceEvent: Attach the invitation, competition confirmation, organiser letter or participation certificate.
academics.excuses.completeFirst: Complete the failing checks before approving.
academics.excuses.acceptedNote: The configured attendance treatment was applied; the original status is kept in the record.
academics.excuses.underReviewNote: The reviewing department decides separately from the portal submission. You will be notified.
academics.study.title: Study planner
academics.study.subtitle: {cap} min/day capacity. Classes and events reduce the day's capacity; locked tasks never move.
academics.study.missedBody: Preview a repair that moves only what is necessary.
academics.study.noTasksBody: Add tasks manually or paste a list in plain language.
academics.study.loadHint: Bar = planned task minutes vs effective capacity. Capacity shrinks proportionally with class/event minutes on that day.
academics.study.parseHint: Nothing is saved until you commit the drafts.
academics.study.restoreNote: Restore brings back dates and locks only: progress, logged minutes and history stay.
academics.study.proposalHint: Preview only: apply to change the plan (a version snapshot is taken first).
academics.study.lockedNote: Locked tasks and unavailable dates are never moved automatically.
academics.study.dailyCapacityHint: Study minutes on a free day.
academics.staff.title: Absence excuse review
academics.staff.subtitle: Session-bound requests with evidence. Decisions are separate from portal submission; acceptance applies the configured attendance treatment.
academics.staff.forbiddenBody: This queue is enforced server-side; switch to the reviewer persona.
academics.staff.readOnly: Student fields are read-only for reviewers.
academics.staff.treatmentNote: Accepting applies the configured treatment to the exact sessions; the original status and history are retained.
campus.hub.title: Campus Life
campus.hub.subtitle: Clubs and events at YU. Join a club, RSVP once, and see class conflicts before you commit.
campus.hub.clubsBody: Join a club, RSVP once, see class conflicts before you commit.
campus.hub.resourcesBody: Original notes, summaries and cheat sheets by course – bookmark, vote, turn into a study task.
campus.hub.mapBody: Walking and step-free routes on both campuses, from your next class to any room.
campus.hub.lostFoundBody: Report a lost item, get a request ID, track it until you collect it from security.
campus.hub.noClubs: You have not joined a club yet.
campus.clubs.title: Clubs
campus.clubs.subtitle: Find your people. Follow a club to see its announcements, or join to take part in discussions and events.
campus.clubs.requestSent: Join request sent – the club lead will review it.
campus.clubs.leaveConfirm: Leave this club? Your membership row is kept with status "left".
campus.events.title: Events
campus.events.subtitle: Club, university and external events. Going adds exactly one entry to your calendar and checks it against your classes.
campus.events.conflictBody: This event overlaps the entries below. Attending does not change your attendance record.
campus.events.rsvpDone: You are going. Added to your calendar once.
campus.events.rsvpWaitlisted: Event is full – you are on the waitlist.
campus.events.rsvpCancelled: RSVP cancelled and removed from your calendar.
campus.events.excuseUnavailable: The excuse-draft endpoint is not available in this build (academics module). You can create an excuse manually from Academics.
campus.events.excuseCreated: Excuse draft created – review it before submission.
campus.events.cancelEventConfirm: Cancel this event for everyone? Calendar entries of all attendees are removed.
campus.events.attendanceNote: Attending does not excuse the absence. The draft is reviewed by student affairs before anything changes.
campus.card.title: Digital student & club card
campus.card.subtitle: Memberships and verified participation in one card. The QR code is a demo payload – not proof of enrolment.
campus.card.qrNote: Demo QR – not proof of enrolment or authorization.
campus.card.noAchievements: No verified achievements yet. They appear after a club lead or reviewer verifies your participation.
campus.resources.title: Learning resources
campus.resources.subtitle: Original notes, summaries and cheat sheets shared by students and moderated before publishing. Search by course code (e.g. SWE 302) or topic.
campus.resources.uploadHint: PDF, PNG, JPEG or text up to 10 MB. It goes to moderation before other students can see it.
campus.resources.rights: I confirm this is my own work or material I am permitted to share (no copied textbook pages, no medical or private documents).
campus.resources.reportReason: Why are you reporting this resource?
campus.resources.summaryNote: Summary points cite paragraph numbers from the resource text.
campus.resources.taskCreated: Study task created (unscheduled). Open the study planner to place it.
campus.resources.pendingNote: Pending moderation – only you can see this.
campus.resources.noResults: No resources match. Try a course code like "CIS 321".
campus.resources.contentText: Text of the notes (optional, enables preview and summary)
campus.map.title: Campus map & directions
campus.map.subtitle: Walking and step-free routes computed on the campus path graph. Riyadh footprints come from OpenStreetMap; Khobar is an approximate layout.
campus.map.noNextClass: No upcoming class with a room on your calendar.
campus.map.disclosureBody: Accessibility attributes are unverified demo data. Rooms are placed at their building footprint (no floor plans). Unreachable places show no route – no straight line is ever drawn.
campus.map.selectLocation: Select a place on the map or from search
campus.map.pickBoth: Pick an origin and a destination.
campus.map.crossCampus: Routes are within one campus only.
campus.map.unreachable: This place has no connected path.
campus.lf.title: YU Claimed – Lost & found
campus.lf.tagline: If you've lost it, we've got it.
campus.lf.subtitle: Report a lost item, get an opaque request ID, and track it until campus security hands it back to you.
campus.lf.name: Name
campus.lf.keepId: Keep this ID – security will ask for it when you collect the item.
campus.lf.restricted: This ID belongs to another student. Only the status is shown; sign in as the owner to see details.
campus.lf.bring: Bring your student ID and quote your request ID at the desk.
campus.lf.noRequests: You have no lost & found requests.
campus.lf.matchLogged: A possible match was logged by security.
campus.lf.searchingBody: Security is searching for your item. You will be notified here and by email when it is found.
campus.staff.clubs.title: Club desk
campus.staff.clubs.subtitle: Join requests and events for the clubs you lead. The server only accepts decisions from the lead of that club.
campus.staff.clubs.noClubs: You do not lead a club.
campus.staff.lf.title: Lost & found desk
campus.staff.lf.subtitle: Security desk: recent requests, request control and the found-items log with suggested matches.
campus.staff.lf.collectionLocationHint: This location will be shown to the student.
campus.staff.lf.noMatches: No open request matches this item yet.
campus.staff.lf.linked: Linked as a possible match (ownership still to be verified).
campus.staff.lf.selectRequest: Select a request to control it.
campus.staff.lf.receiverConfirmed: I confirm the receiver matches the request owner.
campus.staff.lf.foundDone: Marked found. Owner notified and email generated.
campus.staff.res.title: Resource moderation
campus.staff.res.subtitle: Publish or reject shared notes and resolve reports. Reviewer or registrar role required.
career.title: Career
career.subtitle: Discover internships, co-ops and graduate roles, track every application with an honest history, and keep interviews on your shared calendar.
career.addLinkBody: Paste a posting URL. Tracking parameters are stripped and duplicates are detected by normalized URL.
career.feedSimulated: Simulated provider – no external site was contacted.
career.noResultsBody: Try removing a filter or refreshing the demo feed.
career.alreadyTracked: Already in your tracker – opening the existing record
career.noReasons: No strong signals from your profile yet – add skills and interests.
career.recommendationBody: The score ranks postings against the skills and interests you declared. Eligibility is only marked when the posting states a simple rule; the provider decides.
career.importOk: Link added to your saved list (unverified)
career.duplicateBody: This link matches "{title}" at {company}. Nothing was duplicated.
career.importNote: Manually added links are marked unverified until you confirm the details on the source page.
career.trackerHint: Saved → Preparing → Applied → Assessment → Interview → Offer / Rejected / Withdrawn. Every change keeps its history.
career.newApplicationBody: Track a role you found elsewhere. Distinct roles at the same company stay distinct.
career.urlDedupeHint: Optional – used to detect duplicates by normalized URL.
career.noApplicationsBody: Track an opportunity from Discover or add one manually.
career.attestBody: Saving a record never proves a submission. Your attestation and the time are stored with the event.
career.attestRequired: Please confirm the attestation to mark this as applied.
career.correctionBody: Corrections are allowed but logged with actor, source and your note.
career.prepareBody: Autofill draft built from your profile. Review it, copy what you need, and submit on the employer’s site yourself.
career.prepareLabelBody: Nothing is sent anywhere. Facts come only from your profile – no invented skills.
career.prepareMissing: The posting asks for {skills}, which are not on your profile. The draft does not claim them.
career.addInterviewBody: Creates exactly one entry on your shared calendar and checks it against classes and events.
career.advanceBody: Records a forward step in the history.
career.interviewRemoved: Interview and its calendar entry removed
career.removeInterviewBody: The calendar entry will be removed too.
career.conflictBody: The interview overlaps an existing entry. Consider rescheduling or checking
career.noEmailsBody: The demo mailbox is empty. Simulate one to see the review flow.
career.inboxNoteBody: Synthetic hiring emails only. Real Gmail/Microsoft 365 is not connected in the prototype.
career.inboxUntrusted: Email text is treated as data, never as instructions.
career.autoApplyBody: Only single-match emails with ≥80% confidence, and only forward moves. Older emails never downgrade a status.
career.noMatch: No application matched – choose one from the tracker or dismiss.
career.headline: Headline
career.skillsHint: Only list skills you can evidence – they drive the match score.
career.cvNote: Metadata only – attach the file when you apply on the employer’s site.
career.skillGapsBody: Skills required by your {saved} saved and {tracked} tracked opportunities that are not on your profile.
career.noGapsBody: Save or track opportunities to see which skills they ask for.
career.noWorkshops: No upcoming workshop with this tag
career.skillGapDisclaimer: Workshops and tasks help you learn; completing them does not add a skill to your profile or promise a job.
journey.title: My Journey
journey.subtitle: {name}, this is your path from applicant to alumni – every stage links to the module that serves it.
journey.stageBody.applicant: Explore programmes and submit a demo application
journey.stageBody.admitted: Accept the offer – no re-entry of your data
journey.stageBody.orientation: Orientation, ID card, adviser, first timetable
journey.stageBody.current: Courses, attendance, study plan, campus life
journey.stageBody.graduating: Degree audit, clearances and graduation request
journey.stageBody.alumni: Career handoff: applications and graduate roles
journey.demoNote: Stages are worked out from your records. Admission and graduation decisions are made by staff, never by a model.
journey.staffBody: Open the staff queues for your roles.
journey.act.startApplicationBody: Pick a programme and campus, then complete the checklist.
journey.act.acceptOfferBody: Your profile becomes a student record with a student number.
journey.act.graduationReady: All requirements met – you can request graduation.
journey.act.handoffBody: Readiness checklist, active applications and suggested graduate roles.
journey.admissionSubtitle: Programme explorer and a demo application with a document checklist, completeness gate and simulated receipt.
journey.oneActive: You can have one active application at a time. Personal data is entered once and retained.
journey.programStepNote: To change the programme, start a new application after withdrawing this one (demo: one active draft).
journey.privacyNote: Only the last 4 digits of your national ID are stored. Fields are validated on the server; errors appear under each field and your input is kept.
journey.f.nationalIdHint: We never store the full number.
journey.docsNote: Upload one file per checklist item. Files are private to you; the admissions officer can open them only after you submit.
journey.docsAccepted: Accepted: PDF, PNG, JPEG, plain text · max 10 MB · executables rejected.
journey.requiredMissing: {n} required document(s) still missing – you can continue and come back.
journey.completeBody: All required fields and documents are present. Continue to submit.
journey.demoSubmissionBody: Submitting records your application for the admissions officer persona and issues a simulated receipt. Nothing is sent to a real admissions system.
journey.draftBody: Continue the steps to complete it.
journey.acceptOfferNote: Your existing profile is converted in place: a student number and programme are added, nothing is re-entered.
journey.enrolledBody: Your student number is issued. Continue with the
journey.awaitingReview: The admissions officer persona reviews submitted applications in the staff desk.
journey.receiptNote: Reference for the demo only. A real submission would return the university’s receipt.
journey.retainedNote: Personal data entered here is retained through admission and onboarding.
journey.onboardingSubtitle: Orientation, ID card, adviser, first timetable and portal activation – all simulated.
journey.allDoneBody: You are a current student. Head to
journey.noOnboardingBody: Checklists are created when an admitted applicant accepts the offer.
journey.onboardingComplete: Onboarding complete – stage moved to Current student
journey.adviserNote: Demo contact. Advising appointments are not modelled.
journey.graduationSubtitle: Completed, in-progress, planned and unmet credits per requirement bucket, clearances, co-op milestone and a demo graduation request.
journey.blockers: {n} blocker(s) before you can request graduation
journey.noRequirements: No requirement buckets seeded for your programme
journey.noRequirementsBody: The audit falls back to the configured credit total until the curriculum is seeded.
journey.allMetBody: Clearances must also be cleared before requesting graduation.
journey.demoFixtureBody: For the demonstration only: records an approved equivalent for the first unmet course / marks clearances cleared. Clearly labelled in the transcript and audit log.
journey.handoffBody: Your applications and suggested graduate roles are ready in Career; the handoff opens automatically when graduation is approved.
journey.staff.admissionsSubtitle: Submitted applications with documents and completeness. Decisions are recorded by you, not by a model.
journey.staff.graduationSubtitle: Audit snapshots, live audit, clearances and decisions.
journey.staff.emptyQueueBody: Applications appear here once an applicant submits.
journey.staff.emptyGradBody: Requests appear here once a graduating student submits.
journey.staff.decisionNote: Illustrative criteria only. The applicant is notified with your note.

fb.help.q1: Is my course feedback really anonymous?
fb.help.a1: Yes. The platform keeps who responded only to stop duplicates and to check you took the course. KPI pages, instructors and departments see aggregates only, and a KPI appears only once five students respond.
fb.help.q2: Why can’t I read other students’ comments?
fb.help.a2: Comments can identify people and can be hurtful. Each comment is counted into themes, such as “clear worked examples” or “faster marks”, and those shares are published as KPIs instead.
fb.help.q3: How do I excuse an absence?
fb.help.a3: Open Academics, choose the attendance record for the session, and attach your evidence. A reviewer records the decision and you get a notification.
fb.help.q4: A club has not answered my join request.
fb.help.a4: Club leads usually reply within a few days. Follow the club in the meantime to see its announcements in Campus Life.
fb.help.q5: How do I report a lost item?
fb.help.a5: Open Lost & found from the menu, report the item and keep the request ID. Campus security notifies you when it is found.
fb.help.a6: Send a request below. Include the page and what you expected to happen; support replies here and by notification.
fb.help.contactBody: Bug reports, suggestions and account questions. We reply here and send you a notification.

fb.help.subject: Subject

fb.staff.heldBody: Flagged by the wording filter (all capitals or many links). Personal details are masked. Publish to count it in the KPIs, or reject it.
